Method of Attack: Unauthenticated attackers exploit a critical flaw (CVE-2022-45359) to upload malicious PHP files including web shells, enabling remote code execution and site takeover
Exploitation via the plugin’s import_actions_from_settings_panel function on the admin_init hook without CSRF or capability checks
Attackers send crafted POST requests to /wp-admin/admin-post.php with specific parameters to upload backdoors
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using YITH WooCommerce Gift Cards Premium plugin
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated POST requests exploiting lack of CSRF and capability checks in plugin function
Uploading malicious PHP executables via crafted parameters to admin-post.php
Indicators of Compromise: Unexpected POST requests from unknown IPs in logs
Malicious files: kon.php, 1tes.php (marijuana shell file manager), b.php (uploader), admin.php (password-protected backdoor)
